name: Rose, Cutthroat Raider
oracle_text:
First strike
Raid — At end of combat on your turn, if you attacked this turn, create a Junk token for each opponent you attacked. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")
Whenever you sacrifice a Junk, add {R}.
blocked_sentences: Raid — At end of combat on your turn, if you attacked this turn, create a Junk token for each opponent you attacked. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

needs.what: a triggered-ability event that fires at the beginning of the end of combat step ("At end of combat on your turn"), filterable to the controller's turn, with an intervening-if on attacked_this_turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has begin_combat, postcombat_main and end_step but no end_of_combat; the `delay` op can schedule at end_of_combat, but only from a trigger fired earlier (you_attack), which would miss a Rose that enters after attackers are declared and fire wrongly if she leaves mid-combat

needs.what: a value counting the distinct opponents you attacked this turn (across every combat), for "create a Junk token for each opponent you attacked"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has opponents_attacked_this_combat (melee), which counts only the current combat, not the turn
